metadata.title: Cloud Software-as-a-Service Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for safely consuming provider-operated software services where application logic, runtime, and infrastructure are outside consumer control.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud-delivered software services, provider-managed applications, and externally operated service control planes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes trust assumptions and governance boundaries for Software-as-a-Service consumption.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: SaaS trust assumptions depend on provider hosting, jurisdiction, and operational controls.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Software-as-a-Service Core defines the baseline trust properties required to consume provider-operated software services. Because consumers cannot control application logic or runtime behavior, trust is anchored in identity governance, configuration oversight, data protection expectations, and continuous visibility into SaaS activity.

components.title: SaaS Identity Governance
components.description: Governance of user and service identity access within SaaS platforms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid SaaS user or service accounts following compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong governance of SaaS identities, authentication, and session control.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Strong authentication for SaaS user access.
Least privilege enforced for SaaS access.

components.title: SaaS Configuration Oversight
components.description: Governance and review of consumer-controlled configuration in SaaS services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Defense evasion by disabling or weakening SaaS security configuration.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit definition and governance of consumer-owned SaaS configuration.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Baseline configuration for consumer-managed SaaS settings.

components.title: SaaS Data Protection Boundary
components.description: Definition and enforcement of data custody, access, and protection expectations in SaaS services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Credential attacks enabling unauthorized access to SaaS-stored data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authorization, retention, and protection controls applied to SaaS data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforcement of approved data access within SaaS platforms.
Protection of authentication tokens and sessions.
